description: This file contains the implementation of the BestFitBalancer class, which is responsible for balancing resource distribution among buckets using a deterministic, even distribution algorithm. It handles resource reallocation from inactive to active buckets while maintaining specific balancing requirements and provides methods for initializing and recalculating distributions based on active buckets.

classes.name: BestFitBalancer
classes.description: A generic internal class implementing a resource distribution strategy across buckets, aiming for even, deterministic rebalancing by redistributing resources from inactive buckets to active ones.

methods.name: BestFitBalancer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ideal distribution of resources across given buckets.

methods.name: GetDistribution
methods.description: Calculates and returns a resource distribution among active buckets, reassigning resources from inactive buckets in a balanced manner.
